privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: This Privacy Policy explains how Future Pathways collects, uses, and protects personal data in compliance with the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and COPPA for minors.
privacy.s2li1: Basic user information: name, age, school, and country.
privacy.s2li2: Assessment data: responses to career, learning, and values questionnaires.
privacy.s2li3: Non-identifiable usage data: browser type, device, and session analytics.
privacy.s2note: We do not collect or store sensitive personal data (e.g., financial, medical, or biometric information).
privacy.s3li1: To generate personalized career and learning guidance.
privacy.s3li2: To enhance user experience and system performance.
privacy.s3li3: To provide anonymized insights for institutional reporting.
privacy.s4Body: User data is securely stored and retained only as long as needed for educational purposes. Users or institutions may request deletion of data by contacting privacy@futurepath.ae.
privacy.s5Body: Future Pathways is designed for students aged 10+. Parental or institutional consent is required for minors under 18, in compliance with COPPA and UAE PDPL.
privacy.s6Body: All data transmissions are encrypted using SSL/TLS protocols and stored in secure, access-controlled environments.
privacy.s7Body: Future Pathways does not sell, trade, or rent personal data. Limited data may be shared with authorized educational institutions strictly for career guidance purposes.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.s1Body: By accessing or using Future Pathways, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, you should not use the platform.
terms.s2Body: Users must be 10 years or older. Students under 18 must have parental or institutional consent.
terms.s3Body: Users agree to use the platform only for educational, non-commercial purposes.
terms.s4Body: All platform content—including assessments, algorithms, user interfaces, and design elements—is the intellectual property of Future Pathways and protected by copyright law. Reproduction, redistribution, or reverse engineering is prohibited.
terms.s5Body: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and any activity under their account.
terms.s6Body: Future Pathways reserves the right to suspend or terminate access for violations of these terms or misuse of the system.
terms.s7Body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.s1Body: Future Pathways is an educational tool designed for career exploration and self-awareness. It does not provide psychological, clinical, or diagnostic services.
disclaimer.s2Body: While Future Pathways strives for accuracy, results are based on user input and established research models. The platform and its partners are not liable for any academic, career, or personal decisions made based on assessment outcomes.
disclaimer.s3Body: Schools and educators using Future Pathways remain responsible for interpretation, counseling, and decision-making support.
disclaimer.s4Body: Our website may include links to third-party resources. Future Pathways is not responsible for their content or data practices.
disclaimer.s5Body: Our assessments are based on validated research models and proprietary methodologies. Results should be interpreted as guidance, not definitive career predictions.
